title: Herbal Hash with Kissed Scrambled Eggs
description: A gluten-free breakfast dish featuring scrambled eggs with a hint of ethiopian spice and a side of crispy hash.
instructions: Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them together. Add the ethiopian spice blend and mix well.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and add a small amount of oil. Pour in the eggs and cook until scrambled.
While the eggs are cooking, heat a separate pan over medium-high heat and add the hash. Cook until crispy and golden brown.
Serve the kissed scrambled eggs with the crispy hash and garnish with chopped fresh herbs.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
